newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Normandy says no suspension at Ovacik.
newsitem.headline: Normandy says no suspension at Ovacik.

text.p: Australian gold miner Normandy Mining Ltd said on Wednesday it had been advised by the Turkish government there had been no decision to suspend operations of its Ovacik mine operations in Turkey.

"What we have been advised is the (Turkish) cabinet did not discuss Ovacik on the Monday night and, of course, as a consequence there has been no decision of any nature on the project development," Normandy spokesman Colin Jackson said.

A Reuters report from Ankara on Tuesday quoted a senior government source as saying that Turkey's cabinet had halted the operations of Normandy unit Eurogold in a controversy over its use of cyanide in the gold production.

Jackson said Eurogold's operations were proceeding as usual and the regional government had on Tuesday reaffirmed its support for the mine development. Normandy shares were up a cent at A$1.55 at 11.30 a.m. (0130 GMT).
